variants.body:
# HELP radar_info Always 1; the version label says which radar answered.
# TYPE radar_info gauge
radar_info{version="golden"} 1
# HELP radar_requests_total Model requests seen, by model and project.
# TYPE radar_requests_total counter
# HELP radar_tokens_total Tokens by kind, model and project.
# TYPE radar_tokens_total counter
# HELP radar_cost_usd_total Estimated cost in USD at list price (priced models only), by model and project.
# TYPE radar_cost_usd_total counter
# HELP radar_request_latency_seconds Time from the prompt or tool result to the model's answer, by provider.
# TYPE radar_request_latency_seconds histogram
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="0.5"} 0
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="1"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="2"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="5"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="10"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="30"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="60"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="120"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="300"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="anthropic",le="+Inf"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_sum{provider="anthropic"} 0.9
radar_request_latency_seconds_count{provider="anthropic"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="0.5"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="1"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="2"} 1
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="5"} 2
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="10"} 3
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="30"} 4
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="60"} 4
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="120"} 4
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="300"} 4
radar_request_latency_seconds_bucket{provider="zai",le="+Inf"} 4
radar_request_latency_seconds_sum{provider="zai"} 23.71
radar_request_latency_seconds_count{provider="zai"} 4
# HELP radar_tool_calls_total Tool calls by tool and result.
# TYPE radar_tool_calls_total counter
radar_tool_calls_total{tool="Bash",result="ok"} 1
# HELP radar_api_errors_total Rate limits and server errors (429, 5xx), by status and where they were seen.
# TYPE radar_api_errors_total counter
radar_api_errors_total{status="429",source="route"} 1
radar_api_errors_total{status="429",source="router"} 1
radar_api_errors_total{status="529",source="transcript"} 1
# HELP radar_router_events_total Router health events by provider and kind.
# TYPE radar_router_events_total counter
radar_router_events_total{provider="zai",event="rate_limited"} 1
# HELP radar_sessions Sessions tracked, live or ended.
# TYPE radar_sessions gauge
radar_sessions{state="live"} 0
radar_sessions{state="ended"} 2
# HELP radar_alerts Active alerts by kind.
# TYPE radar_alerts gauge
radar_alerts{kind="stuck"} 0
radar_alerts{kind="loop"} 0
radar_alerts{kind="retry_storm"} 0
radar_alerts{kind="context"} 0
radar_alerts{kind="budget"} 0
# HELP radar_budget_spent_usd Estimated spend this period per budget.
# TYPE radar_budget_spent_usd gauge
radar_budget_spent_usd{budget="day-cap",scope="total",period="day"} 0
radar_budget_spent_usd{budget="zai-month",scope="provider:zai",period="month"} 0
# HELP radar_budget_limit_usd Each budget's limit for its period.
# TYPE radar_budget_limit_usd gauge
radar_budget_limit_usd{budget="day-cap",scope="total",period="day"} 5
radar_budget_limit_usd{budget="zai-month",scope="provider:zai",period="month"} 25
